title.narrative: Scaling-up Community Policing Initiatives (CPIs) to enhance biodiversity Conservation, Livelihood and Peace/Security Innovations for both people and Wildlife in Northern Kenya (CPIs-BioLive Project)

description.narrative: The current CPI programme has made huge strides through investments in specialized staff, training, equipment, intelligence gathering and adapting enforcement approaches, which have enabled conservancies to start addressing the threats from poachers and cattle-rustlers. Community and private conservancies are working closely with the Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) and the Kenya Police, and the model is proven to work, but requires scaling up. Therefore, the overall objective of the action is to contribute to improved stability, resilience, investment, and jobs in northern Kenya through the NRT community conservancies, by investing in human and wildlife security.
